subject: Post-call: demo deep-dive — proposed slot-signal schedule
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@meditech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: demo deep-dive — proposed slot-signal schedule

Hi Oliver — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive.

Call highlights:
- Primary use cases: inference throughput for batch scoring + low-latency chat for clinicians.
- Key constraints: data residency for EU customers, need SSO/SAML and SOC2 audit artifacts.
- Success metric for pilot: sub-200ms p95 for chat under the 8-worker baseline and < $0.25 per 1k tokens cost target.

Qualification notes:
- Target pilot scope: 2 models (chat + embed reranker), ~2M tokens/month initial volume.
- Integration: Meditech will run inference requests from their EU cluster (prefer VPC/dedicated).

Proposed next step — technical deep-dive (90 min):
I want to propose a rotating slot-signal schedule so we can include your EU engineering lead, your APAC product owner, and our infra engineer without forcing late-night calls for anyone long-term. Idea is a 3-week rotation where each week we pick one time window optimized for a region and rotate attendance expectations (so the session timing changes, not who runs it). That helps distribute inconvenient windows fairly across orgs.

Suggested windows (all are 90-minute blocks; times shown as local ranges):
- US-window (preferred for Redwood infra deep-dive): 09:00–10:30 PT
- EU-window (preferred for Meditech EU infra team): 15:00–16:30 CET
- APAC-window (preferred for Meditech APAC product): 09:00–10:30 SGT

Practical asks: can you confirm which week (A/B/C) your team prefers to take the initial deep-dive in? I attached a simple availability grid (redwood-demo-availability-grid.xlsx) and a short post-call summary (redwood-postcall-notes.pdf).

If it helps, here are two quick scheduling options I can send as calendar invites right away:
1) Pilot slot: Thu, 31 Jul — APAC-window (we'll record for folks who can't make it)
2) Alternate: Tue, 5 Aug — EU-window

If you'd rather use a Doodle poll, here's one I prepared: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd-rotating-slots
Or you can pick directly on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min (choose the 90-min slot).

Next steps after the deep-dive: confirm pilot config, share a short runbook for expected load, and provision a dedicated test pool for the demo.

Thanks — will put a tentative hold on Thu 31 Jul for now and cancel if you prefer the other option.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-postcall-notes.pdf (summary), redwood-demo-availability-grid.xlsx (availability matrix)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@meditech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 10:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: demo deep-dive — proposed slot-signal schedule

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. This is in line with our needs.

Our EU infra lead (Aneta) is traveling next week, so an APAC-friendly initial deep-dive actually works better for us for the first session because our APAC product owner will be available and can represent the EU priorities if needed. Recording is important for Aneta to catch up.

Thu, 31 Jul for the APAC-window works for us — please confirm the local time you're proposing (you listed 09:00–10:30 SGT?). If it's the SGT window, we can take the 31 Jul slot. Also send any runbook template you want us to review before the call.

Oliver Grant
Head of Platform
Meditech
oliver@meditech.com
+44 20 7946 0124

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@meditech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: demo deep-dive — proposed slot-signal schedule

Perfect — thanks Oliver. Confirming Thu, 31 Jul — APAC-window (09:00-10:30 SGT). I'll send a calendar invite with a 90-minute block and attach the initial runbook template for your team to review. We'll record and share the recording plus the test payloads.

Notes on rotation approach (so it's explicit):
- Week 1 (31 Jul): APAC-window lead (Meditech runs product intro, Redwood runs infra deep-dive)
- Week 2: EU-window lead (more EU infra participation)
- Week 3: US-window lead (final validation + cost/latency tuning)
- Repeat pattern for subsequent weeks during the pilot period so no single timezone carries the burden.

I'll also add a small column in the availability grid where you can mark "must attend" individual names — that will help us finalize who needs to be on the bridge each week.

Invite and runbook attached. If the time looks wrong once I create the invite I'll switch to an exact-zone timestamp in the invite itself.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

—
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
